name: The Gambler's Blessing
summary: On the launch prompt “Are you feeling lucky?”, choose Yes and win the coin. Community guides say a green result is the win.

name: Unlucky :(
summary: Choose Yes on that same launch prompt and lose. Guides say the coin lands red and the game closes.

name: Not Feeling It
summary: Choose No on the launch prompt. You skip the coin and still get this one.

name: You Reached...PEAK!
summary: Finish the obstacle course in front of the Misfortune Van and pick up BANG BANG.

name: Real Gambling is not Cool
summary: Open GET HELP (GAMBLE HOTLINE) from the menu. The Steam guide is the source for that menu path.

name: Big Spender
summary: Spend a lot of money on Floor 1.

name: High Roller
summary: Place a very large bet on Floor 1.

name: Lucky Streak
summary: Win 3 games in a row on Floor 1.

name: All on Red
summary: Bet a lot of money on Roulette on Floor 1.

name: YARLL!!!
summary: Bet on YARL and win a Duck Race on Floor 1.

name: Lucky 7
summary: Roll a 7 on your first Street Craps roll on Floor 1. The live store name is Lucky 7. A May 2026 patch briefly called it Lucky Roll and accepted 7 or 11; guides checked against V1.0.30 say that wider rule did not stick.

name: Spin The Wheel
summary: Win 3 games by betting a lot on the Wheel of Fortune on Floor 1.

name: Risky Move
summary: Win a Blackjack hand worth less than 10 on Floor 1. Steam’s two Floor 1 Blackjack stats were 34.6% and 33.4% on 18 Oct 2026; which stat is this achievement is Unverified, so no percent is shown.

name: No Bust Run
summary: Win 4 Blackjack games in a row on Floor 1. Same percent caveat as Risky Move. The name itself is on the Steam store highlights.

name: Jackpot Hunter
summary: Win at 10x on the Slot Machine on Floor 1.

name: High Roller 2
summary: Place a very large bet on Floor 2.

name: Big Spender 2
summary: Spend a lot of money on Floor 2.

name: Lucky Streak 2
summary: Win 4 games in a row on Floor 2.

name: Winner Winner Penguin Dinner
summary: Hit at least 3x twice in a row on Penguin Cross on Floor 2.

name: Spot On
summary: Bet a lot of money on Keno on Floor 2.

name: Greed Test
summary: Win at least 10x on Crash on Floor 2.

name: Clean Fall
summary: Win at 24x on Plinko on Floor 2. Plinko is physics-driven, so a reload does not replay the drop.

name: Roll the Odds
summary: Profit a lot on HiLo on Floor 2. Steam’s internal id for this percent is ACH_CHA_F2_DICE; the HiLo pairing is the community reading.

name: Spin Streak
summary: Win 3 games in a row with a large bet on the Money Wheel on Floor 2.

name: High Roller 3
summary: Place a very large bet on Floor 3.

name: Big Spender 3
summary: Bet a lot of money across Floor 3’s games.

name: Lucky Streak 3
summary: Win 5 games in a row on Floor 3.

name: Traffic Monster
summary: Win at least 4x on Penguin Cross on Floor 3.

name: Natural Roller
summary: Win Street Craps during the point phase on Floor 3.

name: Step Into Fire
summary: Lose 4 Dragon Tower games in a row on Floor 3. Do it after the quota is already safe.

name: Keep It Spinning
summary: Spend a lot of money on the Wheel of Fortune on Floor 3.

name: No Safe Rolls
summary: Win at 10x on HiLo on Floor 3. Steam’s id is ACH_CHA_F3_DICE.

name: Poker Face
summary: On Floor 3 1P Poker, do not lock cards and win with two of a kind or better.

name: Perfect Sweep
summary: Win at least 20x on Mine Sweeper on Floor 3.

name: High Roller 4
summary: Place a very large bet on Floor 4.

name: Big Spender 4
summary: Bet a lot of money across Floor 4’s games.

name: Lucky Streak 4
summary: Win 5 games in a row on Floor 4.

name: Ball in Motion
summary: Spend a lot of money on Roulette on Floor 4.

name: No Hesitation
summary: Spend a lot of money on Penguin Cross on Floor 4.

name: Marked to Win
summary: Profit a lot on Keno on Floor 4.

name: Straight Down
summary: Lose 7 Plinko games in a row on Floor 4. Bank the quota first.

name: Flameproof
summary: Hit at least 3x three times in a row on Dragon Tower on Floor 4.

name: Safe Exit
summary: Win 4 Crash games in a row on Floor 4.

name: Unstoppable Quack
summary: Win 2 Duck Race games in a row on Floor 4.

name: House Breaker
summary: Win a lot of money on Blackjack on Floor 4.

name: No Detonations
summary: Hit 5x three times in a row on Mine Sweeper on Floor 4.

name: High Risk Wedge
summary: Lose 5 Money Wheel games in a row on Floor 4. Bank the quota first.

name: HARDER
summary: Collect $10 million. Steam’s internal id is ACH_MONEY_10M. Community guides use the name HARDER for it.

name: BETTER
summary: Collect $100 million. Internal id ACH_MONEY_100M.

name: FASTER
summary: Collect $1 billion. Internal id ACH_MONEY_1B.

name: STRONGER
summary: Collect $10 billion. Internal id ACH_MONEY_10B.

name: WORK IS NEVER OVER!
summary: Collect $100 billion. Internal id ACH_MONEY_100B. Guides say minimum-quota days are not enough.

name: Let It Ride!
summary: Hidden. On day 13, take Double or Nothing and win the coin.

name: ...And They Lived Happily After
summary: Hidden. On day 13, pay the debt instead of taking the coin flip.

name: End of the Line
summary: Hidden. On day 13, take Double or Nothing and lose the coin.
